item.title: Familiar Fragrance
item.description:
Something that brings back the forgotten,
A memory from a time long lost,
Just like your old closet drawer, full of wool and cotton,
It time-travels your heart to a place you once belonged, no matter the cost.

The stories your mind once revolved around,
Which you now remember only in ounces,
A distant echo, barely making a sound,
Yet one familiar scent, and suddenly memory pounces.

The power of vowels, letters, words?
I exclaim and say, the power of a scent!
For a lifetime of memories can return without a word,
When a familiar fragrance takes you where your heart once went.

item.title: Beneath the surface
item.description:
The wind mutters a subtle reminder,
The public decides to pull a blinder;
A certainty, that beauty is, what is in heart!
A clarity to keep thoughts within and let not simply depart.
